mapper.select: select * from item order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into item( name, ctegory, color, brand, price, is_favorite, image_name, is_spring, is_summer, is_autumn, is_winter ) values( #{name}, #{ctegory}, #{color}, #{brand}, #{price}, #{is_favorite}, #{image_name}, #{is_spring}, #{is_summer}, #{is_autumn}, #{is_winter}, )
